Aggregated Administrative Budget (AAB) Admini s trative budget created assembling the Administrative Budgets for all functional areas active in OCCAR - EA. It provides the BoS with a corporate overview of the administrative activities/costs planned/expected in a year. Purpose This OCCAR Management Procedure (OMP) sets out the governing principles and fundamental rules under which OCCAR shall undertake its financial administration, including the financial relationship among the different contributors to OCCAR - EA budgets (Member States, Non - Member States, Cooperating Entities and

shall undertake its financial administration, including the financial relationship among the different contributors to OCCAR - EA budgets (Member States, Non - Member States, Cooperating Entities and Observers). Introduction 1.1 General OCCAR manages a wealth of information either coming from Members States, Participant States, industries or generated within OCCAR itself. Clearly, given the nature of the Corporation’s activities, much of this information needs to be safeguarded. Even for OCCAR information which is deemed to be releasable to the public (e.g., a n OCCAR press release or OCCAR information posted on the Internet) changes to its content (loss of integrity) or denial of legitimate access (loss of availability) could result in damage t o OCCAR interests. Consequently , a ll OCCAR information requires protection to ensure its integrity and availability. 1.2 Basic Principles Classified information requir ing protection in the interest of OCCAR , its Member States or OCCAR Programme Participating States , is safeguarded by the application of appropriate security measures as detailed in OMP 11.
